7084-8227-8347.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-8227-8347.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.

222-527-2921-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

265-2073-8249--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
265-2073-8249--90.notes: If the artifact can sacrifice itself, you can do so in lieu of sacrificing the artifact to Defiant Salvager. Also, if the artifact can tap to produce mana (like Sol Ring) or other products, you can do that as well.

4279-4976-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4279-5075-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5075-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3259-5500-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5500-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

728-2757-3249-5173.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Grimgrin, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Shambling Ghast, untapping a basic land.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can repeat the loop but choose to give a creature -1/-1 in step 6 instead of creating Treasure, causing all creatures your opponents control to die.

4186-4247-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
4186-4247-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
4186-4247-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat from step 3.

856-3899-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1671-4050-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

1274-3263-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3263-4186-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3099-6006-6791.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4476-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4476-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1256-5499-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-5499-7730.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

338-6720-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-6720-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-5900-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Lilysplash Mentor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

215-2060-7455.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4} in four different colors of mana.
Wildgrowth Archaic triggers, causing Crystalline Crawler to enter with four +1/+1 counters on it. It'll enter with a total of eight counters due to its converge ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Crystalline Crawler from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2713-2757-7132.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Super-Skrull's first ability by paying {W} due to Zirda, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Wall, untapping a basic Plains.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1636-5125-6972.notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Sparkcaster using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
1636-5125-6972.description:
Cast Sparkcaster by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Sparkcaster enters, its first and second abilities and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the second Sparkcaster trigger, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker
Resolve the first Sparkcaster trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5125-6972.notes: If you control mana-producing creatures, you can tap those creatures for mana instead of tapping them using the convoke ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6835-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1526-1978-2750.description:
Cause Circle of Dreams Druid to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

934-4231-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1274-2086-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4215-5686-6730.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
4215-5686-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

225-5411-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-5411-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 9 for each remaining Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2084-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {3}{G}{U}, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

2018-2292-3216.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

1839-2656--84.description:
Activate Kuro by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Resolve all Kuro abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

2034-4871-5010-5572.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
If desired, you may instead use Golgari Thug's dredge ability to return it to your hand to mill your library.

2660-4377-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Resolve the first Phyrexian Devourer ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it.
If Phyrexian Devourer's power is at least seven, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from your library.
Repeat from step 6.

222-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2265-2445.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1912-4038-4390.description:
Activate Meria's first ability by tapping Farmstead Gleaner, adding {G}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {1} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

914-1235-3277.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1235-3277.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist and Izzet Chronarch with haste.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1722-2034-2835.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Fecundity, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
